summary: The thought bubble works and looks good in the sandbox (frame 2 ms median, builder 0.11 ms, all plugins ok), but the player-facing text still talks about development, and the full suite had three failures that the author did not resolve.

findings.what: Development wording reaches the player in two places. The side panel's welcome message says 'each finished thing gets my honest verdict', and the new thought bubble over Sprout reads 'Builder mirrors the real work', which is a todo title, not something a player understands. The areas.jl test 'side panel talks to the player, not about development' fails on the first.
findings.where: Messages to you panel; thought bubble over Sprout (builder.jl thought!)
findings.evidence: world/reviews/s48-a.png (my own live screenshot: bubble text 'Builder mirrors the real work', panel text with 'verdict'); tests/results/session-0048.json areas.jl failure
findings.suggestion: Reword the welcome message. Map todo titles to player-friendly bubble text and have the bubble say what Sprout is making, e.g. 'Working on my garden'.

findings.what: The builder test (claimed fixed) and the Firefly catch test fail in the full suite ('build did not finish in 70 s, Sprout build idle'; score 0 after 8 catches) and pass only alone. The author's passes were isolated runs.
findings.suggestion: Find the state left by earlier tests (Sprout's goal, crate state) and fix it in the game, then verify with a full-suite run.

findings.what: Todo #250's live evidence is still missing; the human's game shows the bubble and the /sprout/ page only after later publishes or a restart.
findings.suggestion: Take the live screenshot (game = :live) once the human is not mid-game, then close #250.

response: s49: welcome message replaced by a player message (no 'verdict'); the bubble shows 'Tinkering in my workshop…' for todo titles with dev words; the builder can no longer hang (total job time limit), builder test passes after the suite's state; the firefly flake is still open (todo filed, the check now prints its state). #250 closed with the live screenshot media/s49/live-after-publish.png.
